description: This file defines a functional interface 'PubSubTopicExtractor' for extracting topics from messages, with default methods to combine multiple extractors.

classes.name: PubSubTopicExtractor
classes.description: A functional interface for extracting topics from messages of type T, with methods to retrieve topics and combine extractors.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Extracts topics from a message of type T, returning a collection of topic strings.

methods.name: with
methods.description: Combines the current extractor with another or multiple extractors, returning a new extractor that aggregates their topics.
